profile.name: Kyle Elliott Mathewson, PhD
profile.role: Associate Professor, Psychology · Director, APPLab · University of Alberta
profile.about: I am an Associate Professor of Psychology at the University of Alberta and director of the Attention Perception and Performance Lab. The lab studies visual awareness, attention, learning, and memory, and builds portable brain-sensing tools that work outside a traditional lab. I previously trained with Monica Fabiani and Gabriele Gratton at the University of Illinois, and with Clay Holroyd at the University of Victoria.

areas.title: Visual awareness
areas.summary: Consciousness is rhythmic. Alpha oscillations predict whether a stimulus is seen, and entraining that rhythm changes awareness itself.

areas.title: Portable measurement
areas.summary: Recording the brain outside a shielded room: dry electrodes, a few minutes of data, and systems that travel with the person.

areas.title: Flexible electronics
areas.summary: Skin-like, MRI-compatible interfaces that keep research-grade signals while people move.

areas.title: Accessible software
